JDU-BJP Clash Update: 11 navanbar 2026 ko samne aae midiya riports aur bayanon ke anusar, bihar men bhajpa (BJP) aur jadyu (JDU) ke bich tanav ki ataklon ko donon dalon ke netaon ne kharij kiya hai. jadyu ke karyakari adhyaksh sanjay jha aur bihar bhajpa adhyaksh sanjay saravgi ne gathbandhan men puri tarah se ekjutta hone ki bat kahi hai.
